purpose: Define the instance configuration flag controlling whether AccessCore is enabled for the instance, while keeping configuration state separate from current runtime login/session state.

topics.name: AccessCore Configuration Flag
topics.purpose: Define the instance configuration flag controlling whether AccessCore is enabled for the instance, while keeping configuration state separate from current runtime login/session state.

semantics.config_rule: Instance configuration explicitly declares whether AccessCore is enabled.
semantics.definition_rule: AC-enabled configuration is canonical/config state, not itself an authenticated runtime session.
semantics.activation_rule: A runtime using AC-enabled config activates AccessCore through explicit reload/start semantics.
semantics.disable_rule: Changing AC-enabled configuration is a governed configuration change.
semantics.runtime_rule: When AccessCore is already active, an ungoverned runtime command cannot disable it.
semantics.identity_rule: AC configuration does not define caller identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Config visibility does not grant policy-admin authority.

invariants.rule: AccessCore activation, login, assurance and runtime protection are explicit lifecycle semantics; once active, AccessCore cannot be silently bypassed or disabled by an ungoverned runtime/config mutation.

hard_gates.condition: AC enabled state inferred from login session only
active AC disabled by ungoverned runtime mutation
AC flag treated as caller identity

references.purpose: AC enablement is an explicit instance configuration binding.
